title: Eagle-check Fabric Front-stabilizer Kite
body_html:
Product information:
Overview:
This new Weifang eagle kite is crafted from checkered fabric and incorporates traditional Chinese handcraftsmanship. Its lifelike design is ideal for both leisurely flying and bird-scaring applications, while the front support rod further enhances the kite’s structural stability and wind resistance.
Specifications:
Material: Checkered fabric, nylon
Style: Chinese style
Craftsmanship: Purely handmade
Type: Eagle kite with front support rod
Function: Outdoor recreation, realistic bird‑scaring
Optional Configurations and Package Contents:
Choose the size and accessory combination that best suits your needs:
- 1.7-meter colorful high‑flying eagle: Kite only / Comes with a 100-meter spool / Comes with a 16‑cm crystal spool and 300 meters of thick line / Comes with a foldable, effort‑saving reel and 500 meters of thick line


Packing list:
Kite * 1 / Kite + Accessories * 1
